name: Excalibur KOR
description: Excalibur KOR is a small satin column manuscript font. It contains 144 glyphs, covering most western European languages needs.
licenseText:
This font has been adapted for Ink/Stitch by Corinne Renaud. This ink/stitch font is public domain.

ORIGINAL FONT DOWNLOAD: https://www.dafont.com/excalibur-nouveau.font

Note of the author
This Art Nouveau period text type is very well suited for headlines. It is beautiful and easily readable with that special 1920’s touch. It comes with a selection of special characters to cover languages like German, French, and Swedish too. The font is public domain, free for all uses, commercial and private.
